messages.text:
We don't run a price match. Our prices are what's listed on the site, same for everyone.

If you've seen something cheaper elsewhere and want me to put it in front of Georges, I can do that, he handles anything on pricing. Otherwise, happy to help you work out which unit is the right buy. You were looking at the Hammer BC04 earlier, want me to pull its live price and stock?
